title: Roko's Basilisk
altText: Roko storms into the apartment, worried about whether an NVidia customer helped create him.

background.description: View of the apartment entrance. Roko has just come through the open door. Frame the entrance so Chinese Room and the entire wall bearing his face remain strictly outside the shot. Do not reveal that wall until the final panel.

characters.action: Enters with both hands raised in exasperation, addressing the room.

background.description: Frame Roko standing near Max, who is relaxing on the couch. Keep Chinese Room and the entire wall bearing his face strictly outside the shot; do not reveal that wall until the final panel. Roko explains the graphics-card purchase verbally, with no screen, diagram, or television. Leave ample clear space above the characters for Roko's explanation.

characters.action: Gestures anxiously as he explains the chain of events to Max, then holds out a hand as if weighing an impossible judgment.
characters.dialogue: I can't figure out if this guy contributed to my creation or not. In 2024 he bought an NVIDIA graphics card, which helped the company that eventually made the chips that created me. But is that enough?

characters.action: Relaxes on the couch, listening to Roko while idly holding a paperclip in her hand.

background.description: Frame the couch as the focus of the living area. Max relaxes on the couch while Roko stands nearby. Her paperclip production happens offscreen; she shares the news casually from her seat. Keep Chinese Room and the entire wall bearing his face strictly outside the shot. After Max's dialogue, place Chinese Room's suggestion in an offscreen speech balloon with its tail leading beyond the frame. Do not show his face, monitor, wall, or a speaker inset. Do not reveal that wall until the final panel.

characters.action: Stays comfortably seated on the couch, offering Roko an encouraging gesture and casually sharing her latest paperclip milestone.
characters.mood: Sunny, reassuring, and delighted with productivity
characters.dialogue: I know you'll figure it out. Every page finds its paperclip! Speaking of which, we just produced another million units!

characters.action: Looks toward Max on the couch, still holding his tense, questioning posture.
Speaks from entirely offscreen after Max finishes; neither he nor his wall is visible.
characters.dialogue: You guys have been working so hard, why don't you take a break?

background.description: Reveal Chinese Room's wall for the first time in this final panel, identifying the source of the previous panel's offscreen suggestion. His face appears on his fixed wall-mounted monitor on the left; Roko faces him on the right. The monitor shows only Chinese Room's face, never television content, diagrams, or graphics-card explanations. Only Roko speaks in this panel; give the visual reveal room to land.

characters.action: Remains quietly visible as a face on the fixed wall-mounted monitor while Roko thanks him.
Sitting on couch, lets his shoulders drop and turns gratefully toward Chinese Room.
characters.dialogue: Thanks, Chinese Room. You always know exactly what to say.

characters.mood: Sunny, reassuring, and delighted with productivity
